programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: Jake Green is a hotshot gambler, long on audacity and short on common sense. programme.title: Extremely Wicked, Shockingly Evil and Vile

Accidentally double-booked, they discover the truth about each other's secret existence, and are in danger not just from their bosses, but each other.
